description:
Thirty years on a city fire department. Most of that job was walking into kitchens, bedrooms and garages the morning after, and seeing the same ordinary things start the same fires. This channel is what those calls taught me, one house at a time.

Every week: the appliances, cords, chargers and habits that quietly start fires in American homes, the honest numbers behind each one, and the thing you can do about it tonight, usually for free. No panic, no gadgets to sell you. Just a retired lieutenant telling you what he would unplug, move or replace in your house before you go to bed.

New videos every week. Start with the ten things I never leave plugged in at night.
